# CloudFormation

### Known gaps

- Resource-type strictness is by service namespace only: an AWS::Svc::Res whose Svc is unknown to the spec fixture and the provisioner fails with "Template format error: Unrecognized resource types: [X]" (cfn_resource_services.json, generated by cmd/cfnattrgen), but an unmodelled resource of a known service still falls through to the stub path because the committed spec fixture lists types with attributes only. Property schemas are checked only at the primitive level (nested property types are not walked) and the resource spec marks required keys per legacy spec, so registry-only conditional requirements are not modeled; Rules AWS-specific parameter types resolve only for AWS::EC2::VPC/Subnet/SecurityGroup::Id (Fn::RefAll/ValueOf/ValueOfAll attributes per the Rule functions page: DefaultNetworkAcl, DefaultSecurityGroup, AvailabilityZone, VpcId, Tags.<key>); other AWS-specific types yield empty lists. The Parameter-constraint, Rules-assertion and Unrecognized-parameter-type wordings are best-effort recollections of CloudFormation text, not SDK-verifiable.
- Async stack provisioning (default 300ms per step; --cloudformation-provisioning-delay / GOPHERSTACK_CFN_PROVISIONING_DELAY, 0 = instant; a bare NewInMemoryBackend stays synchronous) models whole-stack transitions, not per-resource timing: inside a step every resource is created (or deleted) at once, so only the first wave of CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE_IN_PROGRESS events is visible during the window, replaced resources are cleaned up in the first UPDATE step rather than during UPDATE_COMPLETE_CLEANUP_IN_PROGRESS, nested stacks are provisioned eagerly and merely settle on later steps, and StackSet instance child stacks are provisioned inside the unit (their StackInstanceStatus window is per batch). Update rollback does not model UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED retry through ContinueUpdateRollback, and the RetainResources/DeletionMode validation wording is a best-effort recollection.
- Stack policy: Replacement Conditionally is treated as Update:Replace (deliberate, not an AWS-documented rule), and AWS's separate logical-ID/resource-type default-deny note is not modeled; NotAction/NotResource follow plain inversion (gopherstack-cqy3).
- No nested-stack change-set or public-extension version machinery exists, so these stay unmodeled: CreateChangeSet IncludeNestedStacks (no nested-stack diff machinery), UpdateStack RetainExceptOnCreate, RollbackStack RoleARN, ActivateType MajorVersion/VersionBump/TypeNameAlias (no public extension version catalog) (gopherstack-xhu2t).
- SAM transform (AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31) still unexpanded: AWS::Serverless::CapacityProvider, NetworkConnector, MicrovmImage and WebFunction (their AWS::Lambda::* target types are not modelled by the stack engine); Application with a Serverless Application Repository Location (ApplicationId + SemanticVersion; use CreateCloudFormationTemplate and a URL Location); the translator's opt-in passthrough_metadata mode; HttpApi events that target an AWS::Serverless::Api; a user resource named ServerlessRestApi being replaced by the implicit API. Expanded but not provisioned by the stack engine: AWS::ApiGateway::DomainNameV2, BasePathMappingV2 and DomainNameAccessAssociation (PRIVATE REST custom domains) and AWS::AppSync::ApiCache and DomainNameApiAssociation (GraphQLApi Cache and DomainName) fail the stack as unsupported resource types. Unsupported SAM resources fail the stack/change set with an explicit reason, never silently dropped.
- The Api Deployment hash is SHA-1 over sorted JSON of the swagger (SAM hashes Python's insertion-ordered dict repr), so Deployment<hash> ids differ from real SAM while keeping the same sensitivity to changes; template Parameter values are not visible to the transform, so Refs to Parameters are resolved to Defaults only where SAM resolves them (Domain, Auth, BinaryMediaTypes, layer properties, DeploymentPreference Type and PassthroughCondition, event destinations) and kept live elsewhere; AWS::Region is substituted only for GetTemplate TemplateStage=Processed.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- changeset_diff.go requiresRecreation() covers a curated subset of resource types' replacement-forcing properties: CloudFormation resource property schemas are not part of aws-sdk-go-v2, so the full set cannot be derived (gopherstack-e5h).
- ListResourceScanRelatedResources always returns an empty list: no cross-resource relationship graph is computed for a scan, so MaxResults/Resources have nothing to page or seed from.
